title: One More Chair
credit: Built on Robert's preview rewrite (preview-stories-e4e6722). Lines and reflections revised for a first-time player.

intro.kicker: The student repair café · 5:30, Thursday, raining
intro.text: You're Ren, running tonight's session. The hall locks at six, sharp. Three repairs are booked and promised, including an umbrella its owner is collecting at 5:50. Then someone walks in off the street.

cast.name: Inez
cast.role: finishing the last booked repair, a lamp

cast.name: Sam
cast.role: soaked, bag split open; starts a work placement tomorrow at eight

prompt: Thirty minutes, three promises, one torn bag. Do you make room for one more?

setup.line: Rain on the windows. Three booked repairs, thirty minutes left, then the caretaker locks the hall.

setup.speaker: Inez
setup.line: Lamp's nearly done. Umbrella's due at ten to six. We're tight, but we'll make it.
setup.direction: busy, practical, a little breathless, eyes on the work

setup.speaker: Sam
setup.line: Sorry, are you still open? My bag split on the bus. I start my placement tomorrow at eight. I can't turn up holding everything in my arms.
setup.direction: embarrassed, out of breath, apologising for existing; anxious about tomorrow

setup.speaker: Bo
setup.line: I could sew that. But I promised this umbrella back at ten to six, and she's already on her way.
setup.direction: kind, torn, glancing at the clock

setup.speaker: Inez
setup.line: The library across the square lends bags until eight. I've never checked what they've got. And we could give Sam our first slot tomorrow, half five.
setup.direction: helpful, thinking aloud, not sure it will work

setup.speaker: Sam
setup.line: I finish at five tomorrow. I could come back. I just... tonight would have been really good.
setup.direction: trying to be okay about it; small, disappointed

setup.speaker: You
setup.line: If we take the bag now, somebody else's promise slips. If we don't, Sam walks back out into the rain.
setup.direction: quiet, thinking aloud, feeling the weight of both

extend.speaker: You
extend.line: Sam, sit down, take this chair. Bo, you do the bag, you're faster. I'll finish the umbrella.

extend.speaker: Bo
extend.line: Here, quickly: back through the same hole. Slowly. Pull it tight, like this.
extend.direction: patient but hurried, teaching while the clock runs

extend.line: 5:58. Sam's bag holds. The umbrella still has one open seam, and its owner is standing at the door.

extend.speaker: You
extend.line: I'm so sorry. That's my fault, not Bo's. Can I bring it to you tomorrow, finished?
extend.direction: owning it fully, apologetic, no excuses

extend.speaker: Sam
extend.line: Thank you. Really. I'll be okay tomorrow now.

return.speaker: You
return.line: Sam, I can't promise you a repair that holds before six. Can we get you a library bag for tomorrow, and fix this properly on Friday at half five?
return.direction: honest, kind, steady; not brushing Sam off

return.speaker: Inez
return.line: Here's the address. I'll ring them now and check they've got one.

return.speaker: Sam
return.line: Okay. Yeah. I was hoping to leave with it fixed. But okay. Half five.
The umbrella is ready at ten to six. Every booked repair is done on time. Sam steps out into the rain, holding the bag shut with one hand.

return.speaker: Bo
return.line: I hope they've got a bag.

lesson: Every yes to the person in front of you is paid for by someone, often someone who isn't in the room. Name who pays before you choose.

extend.title: You made room for Sam.
extend.kept: Sam's first day. The bag is mended for tomorrow morning.
extend.cost: A promise to someone who wasn't there: the umbrella's owner left without it.
extend.ask: Who should you have asked before giving the umbrella's time away?

return.title: You kept the promises already made.
return.kept: Three bookings, on time. The people who planned ahead got what they were told.
return.cost: Sam went back into the rain with a torn bag, and a loan nobody has confirmed yet.
return.ask: How would you make sure Sam's next step actually works tonight?

extend.label: Pull in the spare chair
extend.hint: Take Sam’s bag now and shuffle the work.

return.label: Offer the return-slot box
return.hint: A library bag tonight; tomorrow’s first repair slot.
